name: Sign Here
summary: A signature pad on a clipboard receipt with real ink strokes, a pen nib, checks and a stamp
about: A sign-for-your-parcel pad. Ink lands with a little blot, follows smooth curves and gets thinner when you move fast, while a pen nib rides your cursor; you can switch ink colour, undo a stroke or wipe the sheet clean. A scribble that is too short is refused with a shake, typing your name writes it in a script font instead, and confirming thumps a RECEIVED stamp with the time and lets you download the signature as a PNG.
how: Draw on the line with a mouse, finger or pen; pick navy, black or maroon ink
Press Undo to remove the last stroke or Clear to wipe the sheet
Press Type instead (or Enter on the pad) to type your full name as the signature
Press Confirm to get the stamp and the Download PNG link, then Sign again to start over
